name: EditDocument
caption: Edit XML/JSON Document

configuration.description: The document format, exact and case-sensitive. Not detected from the content. Decides the path language: XPath for XML, JSONPath for JSON.

The XML or JSON text to edit, normally a SmartField such as {{trigger_Xml}} or, inside a loop, {{<loopslug>_item}}. An Edit step inside a "foreach" edge whose document is exactly {{<loopslug>_item}} writes its result back as the replacement for that item.

"changes" runs the operations list on the document; "foreach" selects the elements of path and runs the for-each edge once per match, then splices the replacements back. Any other value counts as "changes".

Mode "changes" only; at least one row. Rows: { "op": "set"|"insert"|"delete", "path": "<XPath or JSONPath>", "position": "last"|"first"|"before"|"after", "value": "<text or fragment>" }. value is SmartText and required for set and insert; position is read for insert only (default last). Every element the path matches is changed; a path without a match is logged and skipped.

Mode "foreach" only, required there: XPath (XML) or JSONPath (JSON) of the repeating elements, e.g. //cac:InvoiceLine or $.lines. For JSON the path must select an array; a single value fails the step.

outputs.name: document
outputs.when: always; the edited document (mode foreach: after the last match, equal to the input when nothing matched)

outputs.name: item
outputs.when: mode foreach, inside the edge; the current match as self-contained outer XML or as JSON text

outputs.name: index
outputs.when: mode foreach; 1-based number of the current match

outputs.name: isLast
outputs.when: mode foreach; "true" on the last match, else "false"

rules.message: Pick the format of the document: XML or JSON.
Enter the document to edit, normally a SmartField ({{...}}) carrying XML or JSON from an earlier step.

rules.check: mode "changes": configuration.operations must contain at least one row
rules.message: Add at least one change, or switch to "For each match".

rules.check: mode "changes": every row's op must be set, insert or delete
rules.message: Change %1: pick Set value, Insert or Delete.

rules.check: mode "changes": every row's path must be non-empty
rules.message: Change %1: enter the path of the element to change.

rules.check: mode "changes": rows with op set or insert must have a non-empty value
rules.message: Change %1: enter the value to set or the content to insert.
Enter the path of the elements to loop over.

rules.check: the document must parse in the chosen format; a fragment to insert must parse too
rules.message: The document is not well-formed XML. / The document is not valid JSON. / The content to insert is not well-formed XML: %1 / The content to insert is not valid JSON: %1

rules.check: mode "foreach" with JSON: the path must select an array
rules.message: The path %1 must select an array to loop over; it selects a single value.

rules.check: an operation whose path matches nothing is skipped and logged, the document is unchanged
rules.message: No element matches the path %1 - change %2 (%3) skipped.

notes: Edges depend on the mode: in mode "foreach" the step carries exactly one edge { "value": "for-each", "description": "for each match" } whose steps run once per match; in mode "changes" it has none. The spec says group=false because that is the common shape; a foreach step with its edge is correct even though the validator lints action.edges-unexpected for it.

The loop keeps its state in the step's own outputs and runs total + 1 times: once per match (emitting the edge) and a final collecting run without the edge. The engine's iteration output counts runs, index counts matches.

Replacement convention: only an Edit XML/JSON Document step inside the for-each edge whose document is exactly {{<loopslug>_item}} writes its result back for the current item (the engine deletes the body's outputs between iterations, so nothing else survives). Empty result = match removed; several top-level elements or a JSON array = siblings in the place of the match.
XML paths use the Parser's namespace handling: declared prefixes work as they are, an unprefixed step is rewritten to *[local-name()='…'].
A set on an XML element replaces its whole content, child elements included.
Typical use: inside a "When an e-invoice is created" flow of AutoFlow E-Document for Germany, between the trigger's Xml output and the Return e-invoice XML step.
